action_inputs.description: The ordering group is always entitled to deploy into the namespace. Optionally entitle one more CloudBolt group.
action_inputs.label: Additional CloudBolt Group
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_additional_group_id

action_inputs.description: AKS cluster to create the namespace on, from the Kubernetes Cluster resources whose environment the ordering group can use.
action_inputs.label: AKS Cluster
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_cluster_resource_id

action_inputs.description: Traffic AKS lets out of the namespace's pods: to anywhere, to pods in the same namespace only, or none.
action_inputs.label: Egress Policy
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_egress_policy

action_inputs.description: Traffic AKS lets into the namespace's pods: from pods in the same namespace only, from anywhere, or none.
action_inputs.label: Ingress Policy
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_ingress_policy

action_inputs.description: Namespace name: 1-63 lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens. Names starting with kube- and the namespaces Kubernetes and AKS reserve are not allowed.
action_inputs.label: Namespace Name
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_name

action_inputs.description: Sets the CPU and memory quota AKS enforces on the namespace, its storage and pod quota, and the matching CloudBolt environment quota.
action_inputs.label: Size Tier
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_size_tier

action_inputs.description: Azure RBAC role the principals get on the namespace, with Namespace User: Writer, Reader, or Admin.
action_inputs.label: Team Access Level
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_team_access_level

action_inputs.description: Microsoft Entra object IDs of users, groups, or service principals, one per line, to give kubectl access to this namespace through Azure RBAC. Prefix each with Group:, User:, or ServicePrincipal: when you know its type. Leave empty to grant access later with Manage AKS Namespace Access.
action_inputs.label: Team Entra Principals
action_inputs.name: aks_ns_team_principals

description: Creates an AKS managed namespace with a tiered quota, default container limits, and the chosen ingress and egress policies on an existing cluster, then pins a CloudBolt environment to it, entitles the ordering group, and grants Microsoft Entra principals namespace-scoped Azure RBAC access.
name: AKS Namespace
